**MOPE-1**: a sad wavetable synth and drum machine for the M-VAVE FM-1, with no menus and no numbers: a blob in the rain that is the sound. A fork of FiMba-1.

| File | What |
| --- | --- |
| `mope-VERSION.fwsc` | The firmware package, to install on the FM-1 |
| `MOPE-1.html` | The same firmware in the browser: open it and play |

Install at your own risk. Keep M-VAVE's stock FM-1 V15 ("PC Firmware" at m-vave.com/download) to go back.

   python3 tools/fm1_install.py mope-VERSION.fwsc
